title: Tom and Mia
text:
Tom has a red ball. He plays with it in the park every day. His friend Mia has a blue kite. They play games together after school.

The park is big and green. Tom and Mia like to play board games too. They play chess on a cold day. They always have fun.

questions.text: What game do Tom and Mia play on a cold day?
Why do Tom and Mia play games together?
options: Because they do not like toys

questions.text: How does Tom probably feel about playing with his ball?

vocabulary.definition: a round object that children throw, kick, or hit
a light toy that flies in the wind on a string
a board game for two players

paragraph_translations: Tom'un kırmızı bir topu var. Her gün parkta onunla oynar. Arkadaşı Mia'nın mavi bir uçurtması var. Okuldan sonra birlikte oyunlar oynarlar.
Park büyük ve yeşil. Tom ve Mia masa oyunlarını da oynamayı severler. Soğuk bir günde satranç oynarlar. Onlar her zaman eğlenirler.
